architecture_change: Same as outputs/unetr_style_level0_decoder (real UnetrUpBlock skip-connected residual upsampling chain, level4->3->2->1->0) EXCEPT level0_width is restored to 32 (matching embedding_dim, the width used everywhere else in the decoder) instead of 8. The width=8 taper in the first run was purely a CPU-tractability compromise (see that config's level0_width_rationale); running on a rented GPU removes that constraint, so this run tests the actual intended, uncompressed design. Resolution, spacing, tile size, encoder, hyperparameters, loss, augmentation, and seed are identical to outputs/unetr_style_level0_decoder -- level0_width is the only variable.
level0_width_rationale: Restored to match embedding_dim=32 (the width used by every other stage in this decoder). The prior run's level0_width=8 was a measured CPU Conv3d channel-count cost cliff on the local machine (see outputs/unetr_style_level0_decoder/config.json's level0_width_rationale), not a scientific choice; this run executes on a rented RTX 4090 pod where that cliff does not apply.
